newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - APAC TeleServices raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - APAC TeleServices raised.

text.p: -- Robertson Stephens & Co said its analyst Wayne Johnson raised his rating on shares of APAC TeleServices to buy from long term attractive.
-- Johnson also raised his 1997 estimate to $0.94 from $0.90 and his 1998 estimate to $1.32 from $1.30.
-- APAC provides telephone-based sales and customer service outsourcing.

-- In a written statement, Johnson said APAC's earnings should grow at a 40 percent rate while its revenues should grow at a 30 percent rate over the next three years. He also sees potential upside to his 1997 and 1998 estimates.
